violation_type.title: Critical Injury - Give First Aid or CPR (26 TAC §744.2577(2))
violation_type.short_title: Critical Injury - Give First Aid or CPR
violation_type.typical_finding: A child injured his finger while playing outside and first aid was not provided.

finding_variants.text: A child injured his finger while playing outside and first aid was not provided.
A child was injured in care and required an ice pack which the operation did not have at the time of injury. The operation has restocked their first aid supplies and have ice packs.

The allegation is related to a DFPS abuse/neglect investigation. Based on information received during the investigation conducted by DFPS, first aid wasn't given in a timely manner after a child was injured.
Based on the information provided during a DFPS investigation there is sufficient evidence the caregiver did not render first aid to a child that got up from the ground holding their elbow.
It was found through the investigation that during active play a child ran into a wall, fracturing one wrist and breaking the other, and was not provided basic first aid for the injuries.
